lesson.plain_english: the moment AI moves from advice into care workflow and responsibility spreads across doctors, hospitals, vendors, and patients
lesson.big_question: When does helpful medical AI become something doctors and hospitals are accountable for?
lesson.simple_analogy: moving from a helpful second opinion to a silent co-pilot in the exam room
lesson.common_misunderstanding: People focus on the launch. The useful question is who gains control, who inherits risk, and what changes tomorrow.
lesson.listener_payoff: By the end, listeners should understand clinical risk transfer well enough to explain why today's AI story matters tomorrow.
lesson.operator_lesson: Do not ask only what launched. Ask what new permission, risk, cost, or accountability chain just appeared.
lesson.episode_spine: Anthropic joins Gates Foundation on $200m health AI pledge shows AI moving from helpful advice into accountable care workflow.
